headline: Fighting Gold jumps 352 places into ARC-3 top 100

sections.text: Fighting Gold climbed from 448th to 96th on the ARC-AGI-3 public board, gaining 2.67 points to reach 33.41.
The move puts the team inside the board’s top 100.
